credential_capture.label: Amazon sign-in details
credential_capture.description: Seal the Amazon sign-in details for this source. The connector uses them only for this source's browser-backed collection.
credential_capture.submit_label: Save Amazon credential and start first sync

refresh_policy.rationale: Sign-in and anti-bot checks are common on first login, but the session persists in the owner's browser profile afterward, so scheduled refresh reuses it. background_safe:true records that persistence and recommended_mode follows from it. assisted_after_owner_auth:true means a background run may still ask the owner for bounded help when Amazon re-challenges.

streams.name: orders
streams.description: Amazon retail orders scraped from Your Orders, on the Amazon store the account shops on (amazon.com, amazon.ca, amazon.co.uk, ...), every year the store lists.

display.label: Your Amazon orders
display.detail: Order IDs, dates, totals, delivery status, shipping summaries, the shipping address postal code (ZIP or postal code only), payment method summary, recipient name, and the Amazon store. Per-item breakdowns live in the order_items stream.

shipping_postal_code.description: Postal code of the order's shipping address (ZIP, Canadian or UK postcode, ...), in the store country's format. Null when the order shows no shipping address.

store.description: The Amazon store the order was placed on, such as amazon.com or amazon.ca.

views.label: Fields for matching to bank/YNAB transactions

display.label: Your order line items
display.detail: Product titles, ASINs, per-unit prices, quantities, sellers, product URLs, item-level return/refund status.

streams.name: profile
streams.description: Best-effort account profile read from the Amazon nav bar (display name, Prime membership, default delivery postal code, store).

display.label: Your Amazon account
display.detail: Display name, Prime membership status, the postal code of the default delivery address (no street address), and the Amazon store, as shown in the Amazon nav bar. Each is null when not observable, never guessed.

postal_code.description: Postal code of the account's default delivery address, from the nav bar's Deliver to location. Null when not shown.

store.description: The Amazon store the profile was read on, such as amazon.ca.

reason_display_messages.amazon_empty_history_after_prior_orders: Amazon reported no order history for a year in which we previously collected orders. Your stored orders are retained and untouched. We stopped this run instead of recording an empty history, because a page showing no orders can't prove those orders are gone
reason_display_messages.empty_first_page_without_diagnostics: The first page came back empty and we couldn't tell why
reason_display_messages.item_count_shortfall: An order lists more items than we could save
reason_display_messages.list_page_order_id_not_found: We skipped some order cards on this page because we couldn't find their order IDs
reason_display_messages.empty_first_page_without_terminal_signal: The first page came back empty with no sign it was really the end
reason_display_messages.list_page_navigation_failed: We couldn't load an orders page, so we stopped before advancing
reason_display_messages.list_page_readiness_timeout: The orders page took too long to load. Try again.
reason_display_messages.list_page_shape_check_failed: The page didn't look like we expected
reason_display_messages.no_orders_text: This account shows no orders to import
reason_display_messages.older_pages_deferred_page_budget: We stopped after reading a set number of pages for one year, so some older orders from that year haven't been collected yet. Nothing was lost — that year stays open so a later run can finish it
reason_display_messages.pagination_exhausted: We reached the end of the available pages
reason_display_messages.profile_page_read_failed: We couldn't read the page to get your account profile
reason_display_messages.renderer_diagnostics_failed: We couldn't inspect an empty orders page, so we stopped before advancing
reason_display_messages.selector_drift: The page layout changed and we couldn't find what we needed
reason_display_messages.source_auth_or_challenge: We need you to sign in or pass a verification check to continue
reason_display_messages.unparseable_order_date: We skipped some orders because their dates couldn't be read
reason_display_messages.amazon_no_orders_on_store: This Amazon account shows no orders on the store we read. If you shop on another Amazon store, pick that store and connect again
reason_display_messages.amazon_stopped_early: Amazon stopped showing older orders part way. We kept the orders read so far; connect again later to read the rest
